seo.meta_title: Taziki's Catering: Feasts, Boxed Lunches and Prices
seo.meta_description: Taziki's catering offers Mediterranean buffet feasts from about $14 per person, boxed lunches, Signature Pasta trays and party dips. What it costs.

question: How Much Does Taziki's Catering Cost?
quick_answer: Taziki's Mediterranean Cafe caters buffet-style feasts, boxed lunches, pasta trays and party dips. Buffet feasts with a protein, salad and side cost about $14 to $15 per person with a 10-person minimum, and full catering packages run about $17 to $20 per person. Boxed lunches cost about $9 to $14, a Signature Pasta tray for 10 is about $60 to $65, and dips like hummus are about $10 to $17 per pint. Prices vary by location.
key_facts: Many items can be made gluten-free or vegetarian

body.heading: Buffet feasts and packages
body.text: Taziki's buffet feasts are priced per person and include a protein with your choice of salad and a side, with a minimum order of 10 per protein. At one location, grilled chicken is $14 per person and spicy harissa chicken is $15, and other proteins include chicken kebobs and salmon. Some locations sell bundled catering packages, such as a protein, salad, side and cookies for about $17 per person, or about $20 with two sides.

body.heading: Boxed lunches
body.text: For individual meals, Taziki's boxed lunches include a gyro, pita, sandwich or salad, and every box comes with a cookie. Pitas and gyros also include chips and a side. Prices run about $9 for a Mediterranean salad box to $13 or $14 for sandwich and gyro boxes, depending on the location. Buffet feasts can also be boxed individually for an extra charge.

body.heading: Pasta, salads and sides
body.text: Taziki's Signature Pasta, penne with grilled chicken, feta, tomatoes and basil, comes with lettuce, balsamic vinaigrette and baked pita. A tray for 10 costs about $60 to $65, with medium and large sizes for 15 and 20 people. Salads like the Mediterranean, Greek and Caesar serve 10 for about $28 to $46, and sides like grilled veggies or roasted new potatoes cost about $25 to $35 per pan.

body.heading: Party dips and extras
body.text: Party dips come by the pint, each serving about 10 people with baked pita chips: hummus, spicy harissa hummus, Taziki Dip and whipped feta. Expect about $10 to $17 per pint. Extras include gallons of tea or lemonade, disposable chafing setups (about one per 10 guests) and dessert trays with baklava and cookies.

body.heading: How to order
body.text: Order through Taziki's catering page or a catering platform like ezCater. Many items can be prepared gluten-free, vegetarian or vegan on request. Minimum orders and delivery fees vary by location, and some stores need a day's notice. For regular menu prices, see our Taziki's menu page.

faqs.q: How much is Taziki's catering per person?
faqs.a: Buffet feasts run about $14 to $15 per person, and full packages about $17 to $20, with a 10-person minimum.

faqs.q: Do Taziki's boxed lunches come with dessert?
faqs.a: Yes. All Taziki's boxed lunches come with a cookie.
Many items can be prepared gluten-free, vegetarian or vegan on request.

faqs.q: How many people does a pint of Taziki's hummus serve?
faqs.a: About 10, served with baked pita chips.
